Thanks for flagging — I pulled the issuance logs and admin audit for nina@sparklytics.io. Findings:
- A coupon record for PROMO-PLG-200 was created at 2025-02-14T10:11:42Z.
- Due to a transient race condition during account provisioning the coupon was created but the binding step (coupon -> customer_id) failed with a 409 conflict on our internal issuance queue.
- The billing ledger shows no balance credited for customer_id CUST-98765.

Immediate remediation I've done:
- Manually attached PROMO-PLG-200 to CUST-98765 and forced a balance refresh.
- Added an audit note linking to the issuance log excerpt (attached).

Follow-up items for engineering:
- Root cause: issuance handler doesn't retry on this specific 409 path. I've opened RED-ISSUE-2345 for a retry logic patch and a monitoring alert.

Nina — I pushed the credits to your account and you should see $200 in trial credits after a browser refresh. If you still see $0, please let us know and we'll remote into the console with you.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra | Billing Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
